verdict.rationale: Deel Immigration is a SaaS platform, so natural-language operation is a fair axis, but nothing in the evidence shows a conversational interface, AI assistant or natural-language commands for running eligibility checks, applications or tracking. The llms.txt file only describes Deel for LLM discovery; it does not let users operate the product, and the workflows shown rely on forms, case managers and attorneys.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
